run_gtest_help_test_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_help_flag_behavior: test that the gtest binary prints the help message when a help flag like --help is passed
test_non_help_flag_behavior: test that the gtest binary runs tests and does not print help when no help flag is passed
test_help_with_various_flags: test help output with full flag --help, short flag -h, question mark -?, and Windows style /?
test_help_with_incorrect_flag_style: test that help is printed when incorrect flag variants like single dash or underscore-dash are used
